skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply the basic knowledge of public services and organizational public service management; understand and apply the human resource management process in public service organizations.

Understand and apply the management of capabilities and logistics in public service provision; understand the essence of strategic management in public service provision and apply strategic management in public service provision.

Practice well the skills in public service management: skill in designing public service provision processes and systems for measuring and evaluating the implementation in public service provision; propose measures to improve the satisfaction of public service beneficiaries.
Practice well the skills: problem detection and resolution, critical thinking, teamwork, communication, negotiation, and conflict resolution.

Have the ability to work independently and take responsibility for professional tasks; proactively plan, coordinate, evaluate, and improve professional tasks; have social responsibility, professional ethics; have the ability to self-learn and adapt to changes.
